detect.why: Claude Code writes ~/.claude/projects and ~/.claude/sessions as it runs, and ~/.claude.json at setup. jaato creates only ~/.claude/skills/jaato-sdk, so none of these can be produced by installing this integration.

summary: the jaato-sdk skill — how to build on this SDK, for an agent working in Claude Code
why: Claude Code loads skills from ~/.claude/skills (all repos) or <project>/.claude/skills (one project). Installing from here rather than copying by hand is what keeps the guide and the framework the same version.
